meta.name: pyqt-settings-persistence
meta.description: Implement consistent persistence of user settings and UI state with version-aware migration. Use when app preferences are required.

copy.tagline: 持久化用户设置并自动迁移版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中保存用户偏好并处理版本升级
copy.tagline_en: Persist user settings with version-aware migration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to save user preferences and handle version upgrades in your app

howto.what: Claude 会帮你为 PyQt 应用添加设置持久化功能，确保窗口位置、表格状态等用户偏好能在重启后恢复，并支持版本迁移。
howto.when: 当你需要为 PyQt 应用实现用户设置或 UI 状态的持久化保存时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这个 PyQt 应用添加设置持久化。
say.note: Claude 会生成 QSettings 策略和迁移说明。

say.text: 让窗口位置和大小在重启后自动恢复。
say.note: Claude 会实现窗口状态的保存与恢复。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you add persistent settings to PyQt apps, saving window positions, table states, etc., across restarts with version-aware migration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to implement persistent user settings or UI state for a PyQt application.

say_en.text: Add settings persistence to this PyQt app.
say_en.note: Claude will produce QSettings policy and migration notes.

say_en.text: Make window position and size persist across restarts.
say_en.note: Claude will implement window state save/restore.
